{{Top|leg}}
The '''Skyraptor''' was one of the [[skyfighter]] classes in use by the [[Exocron Airfleet]]. The fighters were capable of reaching speeds of one thousand kilometers an hour, and were armed with two [[percussion cannon]]s and four [[Missile/Legends|air-to-air rockets]].
